146386.overview: 4 Degrees: The Arc of Trivia is a trivia game published by ZAPiT Games in 2005 as a pack-in game with the Game Wave Family Entertainment System. The game is heavily inspired by Trivial Pursuit. 4 Degrees supports 1-6 player multiplayer gameplay with the purchase of additional remotes.
